about: What the Neural DSP Nano Cortex holds per preset, and which virtual devices each fixed slot accepts (NanOS 2.x). Read by lab/gear/nano.py. Device names are as Neural DSP publishes them; based-on names are Neural DSP's own.

manual.title: Nano Cortex User Manual
manual.used_for: Signal path (Performance Mode > Signal Path): 2 pre-effect slots, 1 Neural Capture, 1 IR Loader, 3 post-effect slots; capture volume -24 to +12 dB; BASS/MID/TREBLE knobs act on the current capture; IR Loader HI PASS, LOW PASS and LEVEL faders; six mic positions per factory microphone; AMOUNT knob moves a predetermined parameter per device; device parameters are dialled in the Cortex Cloud app.

faq.title: Nano Cortex FAQ
faq.used_for: Slot restrictions by device; Input Gate sits before the pre slots and uses none of them; 64 presets; 256 user captures and 256 user IRs; ten stock cabinets with five microphones and six positions each; 'Neural Captures created on Nano Cortex can be loaded on Quad Cortex, and vice versa.'

device_list.title: Nano Cortex Device List
device_list.used_for: Every device with its category, based-on gear and slot; the ten IR Loader cabinets.

ir_loader.note: The manual and device list do not name the five microphones; they are chosen on the unit or in the app.
